comparisons.scheme1_value: Farmers who own cultivable land in their own names. Cannot include: government employees, pensioners earning Rs. 10,000/month or more, income-tax payers, doctors, engineers, lawyers, or politicians/their families.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Poor families with Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) or Priority Household (PHH) ration cards. Examples: widows, elderly with no income, disabled persons, landless laborers, slum dwellers, daily-wage earners like rickshaw pullers, rag pickers.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Aadhaar Card, Land ownership papers, Bank account details (Aadhaar-linked).
comparisons.scheme2_value: Ration Card, Aadhaar Card (if linked to ration card).

comparisons.scheme1_value: Online only: Visit pmkisan.gov.in → Click 'New Farmer Registration' → Enter Aadhaar + mobile → Verify OTP → Fill details + upload documents → Submit. Check status anytime on the same portal.
comparisons.scheme2_value: No separate application needed. Walk into any Fair Price Shop with your ration card. Show your card or Aadhaar number, authenticate via fingerprint/iris scan, collect grain. Can use any Fair Price Shop in India (One Nation One Ration Card).

comparisons.scheme1_value: 3 installments per year (every 4 months). No fixed application deadline — registration stays open year-round.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Monthly distribution through Fair Price Shops. No deadline — ongoing as long as you hold an AAY/PHH ration card.

comparisons.scheme1_value: [RED] If ANY family member paid income tax last year, entire family is ineligible. [YELLOW] Land must be in YOUR name only — renting or sharecropping doesn't count. [YELLOW] Bank account MUST be Aadhaar-linked or payments will fail.
comparisons.scheme2_value: [RED] General ration card won't work — you MUST have AAY or PHH card specifically. [GREEN] Grain type (wheat/rice) varies by state. [GREEN] Migrants can collect grain from any state under One Nation One Ration Card scheme.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare. Apply online: pmkisan.gov.in. Helpline: 155261 / 011-24300606.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Ministry of Finance (via Department of Food & Public Distribution). Info at nfsa.gov.in. Distribution handled offline at Fair Price Shops.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Give cash to farmers to buy seeds, fertilizers, tools (farm inputs) and meet household needs.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Give free food to very poor families and migrants to ensure they have enough rice/wheat to eat, especially during economic hardship.

recommendation:
These are two **completely different schemes** for different groups:

**Choose PM-KISAN if:** You own farmland in your own name, are NOT a government employee/pensioner/income-tax payer, and need cash for farming costs.

**Choose PMGKAY if:** You are very poor and have an AAY or PHH ration card, and need free food grains monthly.

**Can you get both?** Yes, IF you qualify for both — e.g., a landless agricultural laborer with a PHH ration card could theoretically get PMGKAY; a small farmer with a PHH card could get both. However, if you own land and pay income tax, you lose PM-KISAN eligibility.
